text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus gained solid confidence and 
positive feedback even in the Senior Year 
Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next Tenno Sho (Spring) is a 
long-distance 3,200m race. Voices of 
concern arose among the public over Ikuno 
Dictus entering it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Ikuno Dictus remains positive. 
She states that precisely because it is 
deemed difficult, achieving it will 
resonate all the more powerfully.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To that end, she made full use of 'IRON 
WILL' to ensure thorough preparations, all 
to take on the grueling battle of the 
Tenno Sho (Spring).
